summary: Riskified Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing Q2 2026 financial results under U.S. GAAP, including 22% year-over-year revenue growth to $98.7 million and raised revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance. The filing also disclosed a management change: Co-Founder and CTO Assaf Feldman transitioned to Chief Strategy Officer - Technology, with Avi Shauli appointed CTO. No special-situation transaction is present; the filing is a routine earnings release with an executive transition, not a forced departure. Advisory or deal terms are not applicable.
